subject.title: fix(agents): spawned agents lose tools with alsoAllow-only policy

question: Should `*` continue to mean unrestricted for spawned-agent inheritance even when the policy also lists additive tools, with only a genuinely bounded `allow` list creating the child ceiling?
rationale: The patch is narrow and evidence-backed, but this shared classifier defines a delegated-tool authorization boundary; the permanent wildcard interpretation should be explicitly confirmed by the owner of that boundary.

options.title: Confirm wildcard dominance
options.body: Approve the current behavior: any effective wildcard remains unrestricted, while explicit bounded allowlists and denylists continue to constrain children.

options.title: Treat mixed wildcard policies as restrictive
options.body: Reject the behavioral change and define a different documented policy contract before changing inherited tool state.

recommendation.title: Confirm wildcard dominance
recommendation.body: Approve the current behavior: any effective wildcard remains unrestricted, while explicit bounded allowlists and denylists continue to constrain children.
